findings.status: CONFIRMED in immutable snapshot; already root-known before audit; root reports fix outside snapshot, not verified here
findings.title: Explicit no-stroke intent disappears on JSON round trip
findings.problem: BitmapRunLayout.Strokes is a slice tagged omitempty. Explicit nonnil empty slice selects TTF no-stroke path, but JSON marshaling omits it and subsequent decode produces nil. renderRuns then constructs a zero-radius glyph stroke; counter treatment depends on nonempty strokes. The input can therefore change rendering semantics merely by serializing it.
findings.reproduction: Construct layout with Strokes: []BitmapStroke{}, marshal then unmarshal. Before len==0 and nil==false; after len==0 and nil==true. Compare no-stroke TTF text containing counters before and after the round trip. Structural serialization consequence established from Go type/tag and control flow; no Go runtime executed in this source-only audit.
findings.minimal_direction: Preserve omitted versus explicitly empty presence in the existing layout type and its current consumers. Extend existing test with JSON round trip and complete output comparison. Root has already chosen optional pointer presence; this report does not prescribe duplicate implementation.
